submissions.decision-fit-transfer-evidence-on-a-disp: SELECT a.slip_id AS first_slip, b.slip_id AS second_slip, a.points + b.points AS detail_points, a.chars + b.chars AS print_chars FROM transfer_slip AS a JOIN transfer_slip AS b ON a.slip_id COLLATE BINARY < b.slip_id WHERE a.chars + b.chars <= 100 AND (a.capture_flag OR b.capture_flag) AND (a.copy_flag OR b.copy_flag) AND (a.master_flag OR b.master_flag) ORDER BY detail_points DESC, print_chars ASC, first_slip COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_slip COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-flag-impossible-gallery-transfe: WITH visits AS (SELECT object_code, visit_no, note_id AS to_note, gallery_code, late_day, LAG(note_id) OVER w AS from_note, LAG(gallery_code) OVER w AS from_gallery, LAG(early_day) OVER w AS from_early_day FROM gallery_note WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY object_code ORDER BY visit_no)) SELECT v.object_code, v.from_note, v.to_note, m.min_days - (v.late_day - v.from_early_day) AS shortfall_days FROM visits AS v JOIN transfer_minimum AS m ON m.origin_code = v.from_gallery AND m.dest_code = v.gallery_code WHERE v.from_gallery <> v.gallery_code AND v.late_day - v.from_early_day < m.min_days ORDER BY v.object_code COLLATE BINARY, v.visit_no
submissions.decision-four-day-closing-balance-intere: WITH totals AS (SELECT o.account_code, 4 * o.opening_cents + COALESCE(SUM((5 - m.posting_day) * m.delta_cents), 0) AS balance_day_cents FROM deposit_openings AS o LEFT JOIN deposit_movements AS m ON m.account_code = o.account_code AND m.posting_day BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY o.account_code, o.opening_cents) SELECT account_code, balance_day_cents, (3 * balance_day_cents + 5000) / 10000 AS interest_cents FROM totals ORDER BY account_code ASC
submissions.decision-frozen-archive-location-manifes: WITH ranked AS (SELECT segment_id, shelf_code, event_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_id ORDER BY minute_no DESC, event_no DESC) AS position FROM catalog_event WHERE minute_no <= 30) SELECT segment_id, shelf_code, event_no AS placement_event FROM ranked WHERE position = 1 AND shelf_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY shelf_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, segment_id COLLATE BINARY ASC
